verdict.rationale: Zulip has no built-in native rules/automation engine for triggering actions on events, but it exposes a bot framework that reacts to messages, incoming webhooks, and 130+ native integrations plus Zapier/IFTTT connectors that can be used to build event-triggered automations. This requires custom bot code or third-party workflow tools rather than an in-product rule builder. Missing for 10: a native no-code rules/trigger-action builder, first-party documentation of conditional automation logic, and independent evidence of this automation actually being used for AI-native workflows.
